rationale: C006 requires accession_number for filing-derived BDC rows so each extracted position remains traceable to its source filing. The raw-source overview for this bundle identifies accession 0001930087-26-000024, and the raw schedule contains investment rows under that accession. The two flagged extracted rows are source=bdc and have observed accession_number blank, so the missing accession is a real extraction/traceability defect rather than a false alarm.
